_what: Where people are in the room, which way they look, and which side the light comes from. Without this a 23-shot scene in one room cuts into nonsense, however good each frame is.
_principle: One axis per location, declared once, never crossed. Every shot inherits its screen position, eyeline and key side from the axis — nothing is decided at render time.

AXIS.SABHA.line: Runs between the dais and the sage's seat. The camera stays on the window side of it for the whole arc.

DASHARATHA.note: On the dais in films 1–2; standing below it from film 3. He keeps frame-left throughout.

VASISTHA.note: Among the ministers until he rises in film 5.

RAMA.note: First appears in M7; before the threshold he is inside the hall's geometry.

AXIS.SABHA.eyeline_rule: Daśaratha looks camera-right. Viśvāmitra looks camera-left. A shot that reverses either is wrong even if the frame is beautiful.

the_one_crossing.what: The reverse wide from behind the empty throne, when the sage turns to leave.
the_one_crossing.why: Crossing the line ONCE, at the only moment the room's geometry breaks, is the point. He has turned his back on Ayodhyā and the camera turns with him.
the_one_crossing.rule: This is the only permitted crossing in the arc. Anywhere else it is an error.

key_light.consequence: Daśaratha is KEYED — light falls on the side we see. Viśvāmitra is BACK-KEYED — the light is behind and past him, his face carried by bounce off lime plaster.
key_light.why: The father is lit and readable; the sage is harder to read. That is character, done with one window.

AXIS.ROAD.line: Travel is left to right across frame, for the whole journey out.
AXIS.ROAD.eyeline_rule: Everyone faces the direction of travel. The one look back at 07-17 is the only reversal and it is the emotional beat of the film.

key_light.side: afternoon sun from frame-left, lower in the west
key_light.consequence: shadows thrown to frame-right, ahead of them as they walk
key_light.time: M7 TIME CONTINUITY — ARTISTIC, NOT SOURCED: the afternoon of the same day. M1–M6 is one audience that begins in the morning; the source gives no hour for the departure, and they reach the Sarayū by nightfall (21.9).

REFERENCE_VIEW._what: Which view of the approved model sheet a shot conditions on. Never left to the renderer.
REFERENCE_VIEW.rule: size + the entity's screen position decides the view.

map.back|any: in-world frame — the sheet has no back view; generate from the in-world plate

REFERENCE_VIEW.never: Do not condition on a previously generated frame. Always the sheet.

CONTINUITY._what: What must not change between cuts.
standing_rules: The lamp stays where it is. Its flame moves; its position does not.
Daśaratha's ring is on the right hand in every hand detail, in every film.
The throne is occupied in films 1–2 and empty from film 3 onward. It is never re-occupied.
Viśvāmitra's staff is planted at his right through films 1–4. It moves once, in film 5.
The sage's cloth and seated posture do not change across four films — that stillness is the performance and a shifted fold breaks it.
Once the king steps down in film 3, he does not return to the dais in any later shot.

per_join.continuous: The frame is IDENTICAL across the join — same plate, same grade, same room tone. Not a similar frame: the same one.
per_join.hard: Location or time has changed. Room tone changes with it.

PER_SHOT_DERIVATION.note: These are computed onto every shot at export, so the renderer never decides them.

AXIS_TRANSITIONS._what: The declared points where the axis changes. A change of axis is not a reversal error — but it must be named, and it must happen on a physical move the audience sees.

TR.THRESHOLD.motivated_by: They physically cross a threshold, out of the hall and into the open. The audience sees the world change, so the geometry may change with it.
TR.THRESHOLD.rule: Everything at or after 07-09 is on AXIS.ROAD, travelling left to right. Everything before it is on AXIS.SABHA. There is no other axis change in the arc.
TR.THRESHOLD.craft: This is the only moment in seven films where the room stops being the world. Six films of one hall, then air. The axis change is how that lands without a word.
